scope: Bound optional Canada Goose product-details discovery and preserve honest captures after a native action timeout. Four selected proxy-free full-API requests exercise this recipe and the existing Amazon, Best Buy and CoinMarketCap recipes. No new full-100 or hosted comparison.

runtimeEquivalence.fixtureOnlyCorrection: Final source adds local alias setup and a fail-closed DNS precondition for the owned integration fixture. The measured runtime and API test bytes are unchanged.

rootCause.savedLiveError: Both engines reached HTTP 200 and then threw locator.click Timeout 2000ms in the workflow phase. WebKit logged a button outside the viewport; Firefox was still waiting for the locator. A failed optional step discarded the document.

fixture.beforeHashDerivation: The exact constant passed to route.fulfill is retained in before.mjs. This hash is derived from that retained source; it was not printed in the original run.

pairedOwnedReproduction.outcome: The same off-viewport owned HTML and native click deadline throw before the repair and return a ready public-body capture with an unresolved optional step afterwards. Neither run fires a click.
pairedOwnedReproduction.scope: Rebrowser, offline browser context and Docker network none; no public target calls. This establishes a functional change, not a live-site latency effect.

implementation.outcome: Unfinished optional discovery/click/confirmation is reported under workflow.observations.productDetails and steps[].outcome unresolved. Only an observed aria-expanded true after a completed native click reports expanded. Caller expiry/cancellation and non-timeout browser failures stay terminal.
implementation.lateActionGuard: Only read-only probes are raced; every awaited result is checked before another RPC and no expired probe can dispatch a click. Native click is awaited under its own timeout, without forcing, replay or a second independent race.

pacing.limit: Slot reservation precedes fetch. Observed gaps are retained; configuration is not an exact dispatch floor.

fullApiCohort.comparisonLimit: Four-target selected cohort after bounding the optional product-details recipe and preserving honest captures, not a full 100-target result, paired old-code test or hosted comparison. No population coverage or standalone primary-only score is inferred.

lastFull100TargetMeasurement.limit: Predates this optional-workflow repair. The selected document recovery is not added to its numerator or denominator.

steps.name: Install browser dependencies for all three drivers
Prepare the pinned optional Firefox backend
Resolve the owned workflow fixture locally
Exercise the production UID boundary and HTTP/session contract
Refuse startup without the required UID or namespace capability

initialApiTestCorrection.cause: The initial assertions incorrectly assumed Markdown excludes hidden HTML. The correction verifies actual hidden state, native-click counters and readiness. Initial source and failed output are retained; all three final API cases passed.

initialCiFixtureCorrection.cause: Ordinary CI lacked the fixture alias and received Not Found rather than owned content. The final test requires loopback DNS resolution before launching a browser, and CI configures the alias. These first-run captures are separate from the scored direct-VN cohort; their destination was not verified local.

validation.finalLocalFixtureVerification: The corrected fixture test was copied into the existing runtime image and rerun across all five engines. Fresh CI builds and checks the final committed source.
validation.teardownLimit: Harness commands terminated their processes, but extract-worker teardown still logged a channel-closing error. Clean shutdown is not established.

formattingLimit: The API Markdown converter can retain text from hidden HTML. Markdown substring presence does not prove visibility, successful expansion or satisfied readiness. Browser rendered-body checks and explicit readiness remain distinct evidence.
remainingWork: Best Buy consumed the primary workflow deadline with HTTP 200 and then skipped alternate dispatch for insufficient budget. Inspect and bound its discovery/navigation stages without weakening original-product identity or Page-close requirements.
The Canada Goose frozen marker remains only in noncontent markup; this document recovery is not a new scored match.
Comparable hosted performance remains unproven. The last full fork score is 61/100 on earlier code; the historical hosted 82/100 reference was not refreshed.

research.use: Native visibility, stability, event-receiving and enabled checks can fail independently of isVisible. Preserve these checks rather than forcing a click.
A native action timeout is not proof that expansion succeeded. The helper observes expanded state and keeps incomplete outcomes explicit.
